Here are five multi million dollar AI app ideas that I wish someone would build. So if you have been sitting around wondering what should you build, just take one of these ideas and run with it. Number one AI generated practice tests chat GPT to generate high fidelity practice test questions, for example for the DMV, SAT, LSAT, AWS certifications. Explain the correct answer, translate the correct answer, and personalize the learning experience for each test taker. No. 2 A low code gen AI version of bubble dot Io. Bubble Io is a low code full stack builder so you can build full fledged web apps with it. But it was built before generative AI and so it feels outdated cause you have to like drag and drop everything manually. I wanna be able to talk to chat GBT to build out most of the application and then tweak it as needed in a low code interface. No.3 A chatbot specifically tailored to content creators. Most chatbot platforms are tailored to businesses. I want the chatbot's knowledge base automatically synced with all of my socials that my chatbot knows all of my latest content. And I don't have to set up separate workflow automations just to get all that content in the knowledge base. No.4 subscription cancellation. People make it so hard today to cancel services it's crazy. I just went through this exercise this morning. There's like 10 different things I have to click just to Cancel a subscription. I want AI that monitors what I'm subscribed to. It can tell what I'm actually using and not using. Then it cancels the subscription just by emailing the billing or support of the other company. No.5 Automated Pinterest marketing, especially for e commerce. Use AI to do Pinterest keyword research and then automatically create pins. For example, if you have an e commerce product, use generative AI to create really awesome AI pins and designs. If you save this video, drop a comment and repost this video, I will DM you three more ideas.
